item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Sen. Bernie Moreno says Rep. Max Miller ‘should not serve’ in Congress over abuse allegations
item.description: Ohio GOP Sen. Bernie Moreno on Sunday said his former son-in-law, Republican Rep. Max Miller, “should not serve” in Congress because of abuse allegations levied by Moreno’s daughter against Miller.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] MetroCon 2026 draws thousands to Tampa Convention Center
item.description: One of the country's biggest anime conventions is back in Tampa, with organizers expecting to surpass 18,000 attendees and generate around $3 million in local economic impact.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Sarasota firefighter hospitalized after medical emergency at house fire: SCFD
item.description: A Sarasota County firefighter was taken to the hospital after suffering a medical emergency while crews battled a structure fire Sunday afternoon.
